[P1] Revisit the breaking-change release plan

CONTRIBUTING rule 1.3 requires removal of an existing capability to follow breaking-change release rules. This PR removes the documented `writeAccess` field from published tool results but releases it as `1.1.0`, so consumers using `^1.0.0` can receive incompatible results automatically. The description's assumption that agents consume text does not preserve the contract for programmatic consumers. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and choose either a compatible simplification or a major-version migration.
